expect_red: planPointerRelease: a release where the press was picks, one just under the slop picks, one at or over it is a drag, and a release with no press is nothing

mutations.contract: A pick fires on a release that travelled strictly less than AA.PICK_CLICK_SLOP_PX from its press; anything at or beyond the slop is a drag and leaves the pick alone.
mutations.note: Off by one at the boundary: a release exactly at the slop counts as a click, which is the smallest orbit a reader can make clearing the pick.
mutations.find: if (!(Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) < slop)) return null;
mutations.replace: if (!(Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) <= slop)) return null;
